فایل MIB دستگاهی را که برنامه نمی‌شناسد: Get the MIB file of a device the app doesn't know from the vendor's site and upload it (text or zip). The app identifies the vendor from the MIB automatically, adds it to “Device type” in monitoring, and reads and alerts on its “health statuses” (such as green/yellow/red or ok/failed) on every device of that vendor — no manual work needed. That vendor's traps are also shown with their MIB names.
